composerregistries.description: A Composer vendor namespace discovered on Packagist.

packages.description: A Composer package whose resource ID is its package basename within the vendor group.

name.description: The canonical Composer 'vendor/package' name, verbatim and unaltered including the '/' separator. This is the authoritative name of the package; the packageid is only an addressing key and omits the vendor, which is promoted to the Group.

type.description: The package type (e.g., library, project, symfony-bundle).

license.description: The license(s) under which the package is distributed. Composer RECOMMENDS SPDX license identifiers (e.g., MIT, Apache-2.0, GPL-3.0-or-later); multiple entries mean a disjunctive choice. Non-SPDX values occur in practice, notably 'proprietary' and 'LicenseRef-'-prefixed custom identifiers, and MUST be preserved verbatim.

homepage.description: The main homepage URL for the package.

repository.description: The VCS repository URL for the package.

abandoned.description: Composer abandoned status: false/true or the suggested replacement package name.

suggest.description: Optional packages recommended but not installed, keyed by package name. Values are free-text explanations, not version constraints.

vendor.description: The canonical Composer vendor and xRegistry group ID.

packagepath.description: The canonical vendor/package path on Packagist.

require.description: Runtime dependencies, keyed by package name. Values are raw Composer version constraint expressions and MUST be preserved verbatim.

require-dev.description: Development-only dependencies, keyed by package name. Values are raw Composer version constraint expressions and MUST be preserved verbatim.

conflict.description: Conflicting packages, keyed by package name. Values are raw Composer version constraint expressions and MUST be preserved verbatim.

replace.description: Replaced packages, keyed by package name. Values are raw Composer version constraint expressions, or the literal 'self.version'.

provide.description: Virtual package names this package implements, keyed by package name. Values are raw Composer version constraint expressions.

source.description: Source VCS information. Unlike dist, source carries no checksum: a VCS checkout is identified by its reference, not by an archive digest.

immutable.description: True for stable tagged releases; false for dev-* branch aliases which are mutable.

autoload.description: Autoload rules in the upstream Composer representation. Genuinely union-typed: PSR-4 and PSR-0 entries map a prefix to a string or an array of strings, while classmap and files are arrays.

autoload-dev.description: Development-only autoload rules, structured identically to autoload and applied only when developing this package.

bin.description: Executable scripts, as package-relative paths, that Composer links into the vendor binary directory.

scripts.description: Composer event hooks, keyed by event name. Genuinely union-typed: a value is either a single callable/command string or an array of them.

irc.description: IRC channel, as an irc:// URL.

source.description: URL for browsing or downloading the sources.

support.description: Support channels published by the package.

type.description: Funding channel kind, e.g. github, patreon, tidelift, other.

funding.description: Ways to fund the maintenance of the package.

extra.description: Arbitrary Composer extra data for this version.

time.description: Release timestamp for this version in RFC3339 format.

sourcereference.description: The VCS reference (commit SHA or branch) this version was built from. Critical for dev-* mutable aliases.

defaultversionsticky.description: Sticky default Versions are not supported: the default Version is always the newest published release.

favers.description: Number of users who have starred/favorited the package.

currentversion.description: The raw Composer version selected for display on the Resource.

readme.description: The rendered package README as published by Packagist. Package-wide, not per-Version.

default-branch.description: The VCS branch Packagist treats as the package default, e.g. main or master. Package-wide, not per-Version.

vendor.description: Canonical Composer vendor and xRegistry group ID.
